name: A Letter Carried by the Wind
desc: A letter that found its way into your bag at some point. Perhaps it was carried here by the wind.

value.text: A Letter Carried by the Wind

desc.text:
To {NICKNAME}:
Hey! Long time no see, my friend.
What's that? You say we just met recently? For a heart that always misses its friends, every second feels like an eternity!
And after such a grand adventure in Nod-Krai, you must have gathered quite a few stories along the way, yes?
Are you, perhaps, looking for an old friend to talk to?
Do you happen to need a bard, one who can turn your tales to verse?
If so, come and catch up with me at Starsnatch Cliff. The wine is poured, and the strings are already tuned.
A Bard
